segments.comment: Two wizard-mode level teleports: ^V, ? for the level menu, and its valley entry to enter Gehennom, then ^V 31 for the filler level below the Valley of the Dead, whose hellfill.lua populatemaze() runs des.gold() through lspo_gold's random square and rnd(200) amount, plus des.object(), des.monster(), and des.trap() without arguments. No recording yet: the Valley's own creation diverges first, in makemon.c m_initweap(), so the filler is never compared; record it once that function lands.
